concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-rakutenpay-flutter-component]] — 2026-09-15 Rakuten Pay Flutter Components Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced redirect add-on with review/cadence-qualified recurring models and DGFT TEST simulator; both prerequisite links misroute to Flutter Drop-in.
warnings: Sessions integration-type link points to Advanced Flutter Drop-in, and Advanced integration-type link points to Advanced Flutter Drop-in; flow-specific redirect/payment links point to Components.

One-off card-on-file is review-gated under stated business-model conditions; without periodic cadence, the card-on-file processing model is prohibited, and every Recurring Processing Model needs application. Shopper permission is strongly recommended wording here.
TEST simulator instructions do not establish live enablement or actual payment outcome.
